cells.quote: Intubation success rates for DL was 71.4% (95 out of 133) with the mean time to intubation at 40.1 + 16.6 s. For the VLs, the intubation success rates were 86.5% (115 out of 133) for the KVC, with an average time taken of 40.4 + 20.2 s. For the KVNC, intubation success rate was 24.8% (33 out of 133) with an average time of 53.2 + 28.2 s.
cells.note: KVNC success was lower than DL; the study reports p < 0.0001. No effect size is printed.
